F1 REMEDIATION (V3-L1, the V2 terminal MEDIUM): book_stress() re-books the SAME TradeSpec set at every tier of the frozen ladder through the same once-per-side cost kernel, so booked stress net PnL is recomputed AT the tier cost. It asserts gross price PnL bit-invariant across tiers and calls assert_stress_rows_distinct() internally: on a non-empty trade set, base/tier1.5/tier2.0 booked rows (trade_id, net_pnl_usd) must be pairwise distinct or the kernel raises STRESS_ROWS_NOT_DISTINCT (fail closed). The V2 defect (tier1.5 rows byte-identical to base; tier2.0 at base costs) cannot pass through this path.

V3-L2 separation: each StressBookResult carries cost_component_delta_vs_base_usd (a PURE cost component, proven by the gross-invariance assertion) and carries fill_delay_events as separately recorded metadata that never enters any PnL in this kernel.

Dual book: DualBookTrade frozen records plus build_scored_record() carry price_only_pnl_usd and financing_adjusted_pnl_usd as SEPARATE immutable digest-covered columns; validate_scored_record() fails closed DUAL_BOOK_VIOLATION on any post-digest mutation or missing/nonnull-finite column. financing_adjustment_usd is a carried parameter (scalar or per-trade mapping, must cover every trade id); the formula that produces it is frozen in P3 and is NOT computed anywhere in this kernel.

Break-even bps from the SAME cost kernel: break_even_bps() inverts the charging primitive per_side_cost_usd (bps_cost == per_side_cost_usd(notional, 1.5*tier) exactly for every tier); derivation documented in the docstring: b* = (G/n) * 10000 / (2N); at b* the booked net of the same trades is exactly zero; None for an empty book; 6-decimal publication rounding per the V2 convention.
